name: EuroTeleSites AG
summary: Headquartered in Vienna, Austria, and established in 2023, EuroTeleSites AG specializes in developing and operating wireless communication infrastructure. The company extends its services across Austria, Bulgaria, Croatia, Slovenia, North Macedonia, and Serbia, focusing on the construction and management of telecommunication sites. These sites provide essential offerings, including space allocation, energy solutions, and other related services. EuroTeleSites AG operates as a subsidiary of América Móvil B.V.
